geometry.towers: 8 round towers, four on each long side; eastern two middle towers project outward.
geometry.courtyards: Smaller northern Cour du Puits, larger southern Grande Cour separated by transverse building wing near northern third.
geometry.roofline: Towers and curtain walls have one continuous, almost level fortified parapet; flat terraces, machicolations and crenellations, no tall cone roofs.
geometry.scale_status: Approximate only. Outer envelope from prior local Sellier measurement (single source); historical overall 66x34 / 68x37 uses ambiguous measurement bounds. Height circa 24m from Coeuret via local source report; not verified against two independent sources.
geometry.division_wing: A lower transverse building is visible in Sellier. Three storeys / 1761 is only stated by Coeuret via local report, not independently verified.
geometry.modern_overlay_warning: Sellier includes 1899 streets, metro line, current houses, July Column; omit all these from 1789 building geometry.
